mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 2.0%, it triggers immediate market anticipation of growth-supportive policy, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in nonfarm payrolls signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The UNRATE-PAYEMS interaction yields positive returns in less than 60% of 60-day horizons, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1300 thousand units indicate robust consumer demand for housing, which precedes broader economic strength and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in less than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1300, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of INDPRO rise instances, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent price pressures that trigger market expectations of monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of CPIAUCSL > 2.5% instances, or Rank IC is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), tight labor markets support elevated consumer spending and corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in less than 50% of UNRATE < 3.5% instances, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL > 2.0% indicates policy easing amid inflation, generating positive equity returns as growth expectations rise without excessive inflation over 20 days.
failure_condition: The FEDFUNDS-CPIAUCSL interaction yields positive returns in less than 60% of 20-day horizons, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.
